description: Send a 6-digit verification code to an email address. This is the first step to create a ClearList account or sign in. The user will receive the code in their inbox. Ask them to tell you the code, then use verify_code to complete authentication. No API key needed for this step. Send ONE code and wait for the user to read it. Sending another invalidates the previous one, so a second send while they are fetching the first makes the code they are holding fail. Only re-send if they say they never received it or the code has expired (10 minutes).

email.description: The email address to send the verification code to
